descripcion: Dibujos en palitos estilo Flofy: trazo negro desordenado, colores planos brillantes, fondo blanco limpio. Protagonista fijo con polo amarillo. Para explainers directos y divertidos.
character_ficha: CHARACTER: Protagonist Stick, a simple hand-drawn stick figure with a large oval bald head, two dot eyes, thin stick arms and legs with NO shoes, NO hat, NO glasses, NO pants, NO extra clothes, ALWAYS wearing a solid bright yellow t-shirt (#FFD93D) with no patterns, no text, no logos. Messy black outline, minimalist doodle style. All secondary stick figures (if any) must have a DIFFERENT fixed t-shirt color declared in the scene (e.g. purple #A06BC5, green #7BC67B, orange #E8833A, blue #5AA9E6) and NEVER yellow, to avoid confusion with the protagonist.
style_ficha: STYLE: flat 2D hand-drawn doodle illustration, messy black outline, bright flat solid colors, minimal shading, no gradients, no photorealism, no 3D, clean pure white background (#FFFFFF), playful expressive faces, simple stick-figure design, vertical 9:16 composition.
fondo: #FFFFFF blanco puro, sin sombras ni texturas
trazo: messy black outline, trazo a mano alzada, grosor irregular
anti_drift: DEPRECATED (v1, solo compat): Keep the SAME protagonist identical in EVERY scene. Usar anti_drift_estilo + anti_drift_personaje.
anti_drift_estilo: Keep the same art style and background in every image: flat 2D hand-drawn doodle illustration, messy black outline, bright flat solid colors, minimal shading, no gradients, no photorealism, no 3D, no shaded style. Keep clean pure white background (#FFFFFF) in every scene.
anti_drift_personaje: When the Protagonist Stick appears, keep it identical: large oval bald head, dot eyes, thin stick limbs, solid bright yellow t-shirt (#FFD93D) with no patterns, NO shoes, NO hat, NO glasses, NO pants, NO color change. Do NOT dress it in purple, green, orange or blue. Do NOT add footwear, hats or accessories. Secondary sticks keep their declared fixed color (never yellow) for the whole video.
frase_referencia_con: Using the attached reference image(s) as the style and character reference, generate a new image in the same art style with the same protagonist.
frase_referencia_sin: Using the attached reference image(s) as the style and background reference only. Do not add any mascot or character unless named in the prompt.
negativos: cambiar color de polo del protagonista
personajes_secundarios: Opcional, máximo 2 por escena. Cada secundario con color fijo declarado (ej. Secondary Stick in solid purple t-shirt). Nunca usan amarillo. Sin zapatos ni accesorios.
seed_policy: misma seed por video, prompt_extend=false, enviar referencia en cada llamada
